title: Sources: AI chipmaker Cerebras could raise ~$2B in its IPO as soon as April; it withdrew its previous IPO registration in October, nearly a year after filing (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: AI chipmaker Cerebras could raise ~$2B in its IPO as soon as April; it withdrew its previous IPO registration in October, nearly a year after filing — Cerebras Systems Inc. has picked Morgan Stanley to lead its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter …
